description: This file contains unit tests for the jjwg_Areas class in the SuiteCRM project, utilizing PHPUnit framework. It tests the creation, configuration, retrieval, and various geographic calculations related to area polygons within the jjwg_Areas module.

classes.name: jjwg_AreasTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing functionality of the jjwg_Areas module.

methods.name: testjjwg_Areas
methods.description: Tests the initialization and basic attributes of the jjwg_Areas bean instance.

methods.name: testconfiguration
methods.description: Tests the configuration method and related settings of jjwg_Areas.

methods.name: testretrieve
methods.description: Tests the retrieval method and its behavior with and without pre-set attributes.

methods.name: testdefine_polygon
methods.description: Tests the define_polygon method, ensuring correct polygon array output.

methods.name: testdefine_area_loc
methods.description: Tests the define_area_loc method for correct location data based on attributes.

methods.name: testdefine_centroid
methods.description: Tests the centroid calculation from coordinates.

methods.name: testdefine_area
methods.description: Tests the area calculation from coordinate data.

methods.name: testdefine_loc
methods.description: Tests the define_loc method which creates locationary data from an array.

methods.name: testis_marker_in_area
methods.description: Tests whether a marker is inside the area based on set coordinates.

methods.name: testis_point_in_area
methods.description: Checks if a point with given lat/lng falls inside the polygon area.

methods.name: testpoint_in_polygon
methods.description: Tests the point-in-polygon algorithm for correctness.

methods.name: testpoint_on_vertex
methods.description: Checks if a point is exactly on a vertex of the polygon.

methods.name: testpoint_string_to_coordinates
methods.description: Verifies parsing of coordinate string to array.
